response.rationale: The smartwatch is an electronics item delivered 16 days ago. Electronics have a stricter 15-day return window (RET-003, priority 20), which dominates the standard 30-day rule (RET-007, priority 10). Since 16 > 15, the return is not accepted. No higher-priority exceptions apply: the item is not defective (RET-020), not final sale (RET-012), no goodwill grant (RET-050), and no fraud hold (RET-051).
